Alt text: The image contains Hindi text written in orange color. The text reads: 
"खामोशियाँ सब्र का इम्तिहान बन गयी,
मजबूरियाँ प्यार में इल्जाम बन गयी,
वो आये और आकर चले गये,
खुशियाँ चन्द लम्हों की मेहमान बन गयी।"
The text also includes a watermark with the URL "tucmuc.blogspot.com" and "www.tucmuc.org".

compos.summarization:
This smartphone UI screen appears to be displaying a social media post in Hindi. The main contents and functions of this UI screen include:

1. **Text Content**: The main body of the screen contains a Hindi quote or poem, which seems to be an emotional or philosophical statement.

2. **User Interaction Options**:
   - **Share (शेयर)**: Allows the user to share the post.
   - **Like (है पसंद)**: Shows the number of likes (164) and allows the user to like the post.
   - **Comment (टिप्पणी करें)**: Shows the number of comments (60) and allows the user to comment on the post.
   - **Save (बाद में पढ़ें)**: Allows the user to save the post for later reading.

3. **User Information**: The top right corner shows a user profile picture and the time (7:42).

4. **Navigation**: The top left corner has a back arrow
